mcq.q: Decode at small batch is usually limited by…
mcq.why: Each step reads all weights for little arithmetic, so bandwidth dominates.

mcq.q: What does paged attention mainly fix?
mcq.why: Fixed-size blocks allocated on demand avoid reserving max-length contiguous memory.

mcq.q: A 70B model on 4 GPUs with TP=4 is how many serving units for redundancy?
mcq.why: The tensor-parallel group serves as one unit; losing any GPU stops it.
